_comment: Template for .pose/public/claims.json — copy it there and edit. Declares what your public surfaces claim about the CURRENT product, so a surface that contradicts a released fact fails `pose public-claims` instead of ageing quietly. Surfaces are declared, never discovered: a scanner that flagged every version-shaped string would fail on changelogs, historical assessments and release notes, which are supposed to name old versions.

product.name: <product name as the public surfaces call it>
product.docs_canonical: https://<the one URL docs should point at>

docs_hosts.canonical: https://<the one URL docs should point at>
deprecated: <any host still linked from somewhere, so a stale link is reported>

surfaces.note: current-only: a version may appear, but only the released one. Use it where an install command has to pin an exact version.
none: this surface must not name a version at all. Use it for evergreen pages, where a version is the thing that goes stale.
